text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I really thought I would win this time… And after all those long hours of training…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Even if it's gradual, you're still making progress.
Let's just focus on the day you do win!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're right. I've noticed my improvement during training, and I'm definitely performing better than I did in my first race…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll be okay now! Even if it's slow, I know I'm still making progress, little by little!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll work even harder starting today. I'm counting on your guidance!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Feeling sorry for myself isn't going to help me improve. I have to keep running and have faith that I'll win someday!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer! I'm ready to get back to work!
